method: Unsaved editor fixture, actual Hero constructor/held axe, SingleNode SetPosition(false), editor ticks, compressed AnimPose pose verification and SceneCapture next-tick PNG export

current_attack.sampling_method: set_position then editor ticks until actual component hand/head/pelvis match separately evaluated compressed asset pose

original_chop.sampling_method: set_position then editor ticks until actual component hand/head/pelvis match separately evaluated compressed asset pose

limitations: Single-node pose excludes native graph blend and normal input/action clock
Height peak is not a contact event
No sockets or grip alignment changed

measured_endpoint_candidates.status: Not yet selected from the actual imported mesh; exported vertices and actual axe transforms permit later exact world-coordinate evaluation without replay

fixture_visibility_change: HeldAxe made visible only for sampling; no normal equip/Combat transaction executed

attack_hand_height_peak.meaning: Measured hand height maximum within sampled range; not blade contact or damage time

chop_first_half_hand_height_peak.meaning: Measured hand height maximum within sampled range; not blade contact or damage time
